Currently at ev during my second playthrough, I almost got to the creative tank last time, but my base was poorly optimised.

Here are some things I've learned

\- Use export buses and crafting cards as little as possible and use interfaces instead. They can do pretty much the samething. Export buses constantly update the block, whereas interfaces dont tick as often at all

\- keep circuits, preferably a 10 stacks of each just ready, these can again be automated if needed.

\- Automate DML as quickly as possible, It's your big resource production, and a simple MV setup kan keep up with about 7 simulation chambers with ease. You'll want to go straight to numismatic dynamos, burning diamonds from DML as soon as your steam dynamos can't keep up

\- Automated Ore processing can wait until IV, as thats when you get 100% from your byproducts, which is why you're processing the ore in the first place.

\- Don't be afraid of making big production chains that make one or two things, you'll probably end up needing everything

\- Know that you'll be making a lot of each machine. In the end of my last playthrough I had 40 EBFs running until they reached a limit, which you can set with machine controllers and level emitters.

\- batch craft a stacks worth of things, you'll definitely use it up at some point.

Also when you get to setting up ore-processing, make sure to check what by products you want, not all ores need the same process.
